dialogue.speaker: Hao
dialogue.text: 你有几分钟吗？我想听听你对我演讲的反馈。
dialogue.en: Do you have a few minutes? I would like some feedback on my presentation.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 当然。首先，结构很清楚，你的例子也很有趣。
dialogue.en: Of course. First of all, the structure was clear and your examples were interesting.

dialogue.speaker: Hao
dialogue.text: 谢谢。那我可以改进什么？
dialogue.en: Thank you. And what could I improve?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 我有个建议：尽量说慢一点，尤其是开头。
dialogue.en: I have a suggestion: try to speak more slowly, especially at the beginning.

dialogue.speaker: Hao
dialogue.text: 我确实很紧张。真的很明显吗？
dialogue.en: I did feel nervous. Was it really noticeable?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 有一点，但很容易改。在要点之间稍微停顿一下就会有帮助。
dialogue.en: A little, but it is easy to fix. A short pause between the main points would help.

dialogue.speaker: Hao
dialogue.text: 还有别的吗？请坦诚说。我能接受批评。
dialogue.en: Anything else? Please be honest. I can take criticism.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 最后几张幻灯片文字太多，所以观众开始读而不是听。
dialogue.en: The final slides had too much text, so the audience started reading instead of listening.

dialogue.speaker: Hao
dialogue.text: 这很有帮助。你能具体说一下是哪几张吗？
dialogue.en: That is helpful. Could you be more specific about which slides?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 第八张和第九张。用一张图和一句话来代替。
dialogue.en: Slides eight and nine. Use one image and one sentence instead.

dialogue.speaker: Hao
dialogue.text: 我会这么做的。说实话，我还担心讲得很糟糕。
dialogue.en: I will do that. Honestly, I was afraid it had gone badly.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 一点也不。比起你上次的演讲，你有了真正的进步。
dialogue.en: Not at all. You have made real progress since your last presentation.

dialogue.speaker: Hao
dialogue.text: 这真的激励我继续练习。
dialogue.en: That really motivates me to keep practicing.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 很好。建设性的反馈应该激励人，而不是让人泄气。
dialogue.en: Good. Constructive feedback should motivate people, not discourage them.

dialogue.speaker: Hao
dialogue.text: 同意。下周要不要我也给你的演讲提些反馈？
dialogue.en: Agreed. Would you like me to give you feedback on yours next week?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: 我会很感激。谢谢你对此持开放态度。
dialogue.en: I would be grateful. Thank you for being open to it.
